g.text: A matching middle entry moves the right bound

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #283341

g.text: to that entry, so earlier matches remain eligible.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #283341

g.text: Source lookup keeps the first cumulative match

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #283341

g.text: Zero counts repeat a prefix value. The search selects the first prefix at or above the particle ID.
